sync.ingestTooltip: Write sync snapshot from current corpus
sync.ingestDescription: Reads the current corpus and writes a new sync state snapshot to data/runtime/sync-state.json. Fast, local operation — no network calls.
sync.analyzeTooltip: Post-ingest corpus enrichment with additive analysis blocks
sync.analyzeDescription: Scans the current corpus, selects bounded candidates, and calls the configured AI provider to enrich each document with summary and classification metadata. Results are written to data/runtime/analyzed-corpus.json.
sync.analyzeWarning: This makes API calls to your configured provider (OpenAI, Gemini, or Anthropic) and will consume tokens. Cost depends on corpus size and provider rates. Make sure a valid API key is set in Settings before running.
sync.publishTooltip: Promote the analyzed corpus into the live app snapshot
sync.publishDescription: Publishes data/runtime/analyzed-corpus.json into public/live-corpus.json so the app reads the analyzed snapshot as its live corpus.
sync.publishWarning: This updates the published live corpus consumed by the app. Run Analyze first if you want fresh analysis results included.
sync.evaluateTooltip: Score retrieval quality against expected answers
sync.evaluateDescription: Runs the evaluation pipeline and scores retrieval quality against a set of expected answers. Writes a baseline report to data/eval/.
sync.evaluateWarning: This makes API calls to OpenAI and may incur usage costs.
sync.refreshTooltip: Reload corpus state in the app
sync.refreshDescription: Reloads the corpus state in the app and updates site coverage, freshness, and provider readiness signals. No files are written.
sync.startTooltip: Full SharePoint export via Microsoft Graph
sync.startDescription: Connects to SharePoint via Microsoft Graph and exports the full corpus from all configured sites. The existing checkpoint will be overwritten.
sync.startWarning: Full sync — may take several minutes depending on corpus size. Requires Entra credentials configured in Settings.
sync.resumeDescription: Resumes from the last checkpoint and only fetches documents modified since the previous export. Faster than a full export and preserves unchanged documents.
sync.resumeWarning: Requires a valid checkpoint on disk. If no checkpoint exists the export will fall back to a full run.
